treatment.logline: At a rain-soaked canal gate, Aruni's interrupted journey becomes a restrained recognition, a marked-key mystery and an unanswered attempt to reach help.

arc.beat: Journey interrupted; identify the still figure
Lowering and contact, then the marked fist
The world continues; image ends; title stands apart

treatment.approach: Build a sixty-second reference assembly from essential, predominantly locked-off material. The unusually short scripted action earns duration through the geographic master, the recognition single, a held identification angle, the lowering, the contained response, the key reveal and the unanswered connection. These are distinct steps, not three-angle coverage of every gesture. No music, spectacular weather changes or invented explanation. End in editorial black and a separate title source.

treatment.geography: The paddy path leads screen left to right toward the canal gate. Nimal lies along the concrete edge at frame right, head toward the gate. Aruni approaches from frame left and kneels on his path side. Keep cameras on the field side of this axis. Choose the medical bag in her left hand throughout; her right hand is available for the brief obscured contact and later the phone.
treatment.key_image: A small metal key marked C-17 remains enclosed in a motionless fist while rain continues around it.
advice: Do not show a key transfer, falling key or any suggestion of what it opens.
Keep the contact hidden behind the near shoulder rather than generating touching hands.
Use stillness and held eyes instead of an expressive outburst.
The phone is an implicit means of the scripted contact attempt, not a new message or source of information.
Black and title are separate editorial elements, not photographed objects.

moments.what: Aruni's progress beside the field stops; she notices the figure, and the audience identifies Nimal at the gate.
moments.feeling: Recognition arrives in stages without an outburst.
moments.cut_uses: Locked wide master establishes the path; field-side single holds Aruni's stop; a low field-side identification single reveals Nimal. Each is a necessary stage of the discovery.

moments.what: Aruni lowers beside Nimal and reaches to his hand, with contact concealed; hold her contained response after she settles.
moments.feeling: A practical gesture struggles to contain the discovery.
moments.cut_uses: Field-side medium two-shot carries the lowering with the hand-contact area occluded; a settled single then holds her face, not a replay of the lowering.

moments.what: The marking on the metal key is visible within Nimal's fist; the key remains there.
moments.feeling: An unanswered material clue interrupts grief.
moments.cut_uses: Locked detail at fist height is the sole necessary picture of this reveal, with C-17 legible.

moments.what: Aruni performs L3 with held-back urgency.
moments.cut_uses: Locked eye-level single performs the complete line, with no cut within it.

moments.what: Still kneeling with the bag, Aruni attempts phone contact and receives no response.
moments.cut_uses: A sustained field-side medium single keeps her face and phone visible; avoid invented screen information or an absent person's image.

moments.what: A distant bus horn mixes with the rain as Aruni remains beside the gate.
moments.feeling: The wider world continues without helping.
moments.cut_uses: A tight held reaction receives the remote sound; no vehicle cutaway.
Plain black source; the hard cut is editorial, not a camera effect.

moments.what: Present the title separately on black.
moments.cut_uses: Static title source reading EKAMA SAKSHIYA, replaceable with a clean post-generated card.

editor_notes: The bin is 60 seconds across 11 must sources; the intended cut is a reference, not a locked edit. Play the wide, recognition and identification in sequence, then the lowering and settled reaction, then the key, L3, the attempt, the horn, black and title.

The script does not specify hands or wardrobe: staging assigns the medical bag to Aruni's left hand and the enclosed key to Nimal's right fist; keep those assignments throughout. The phone appears in Aruni's right hand at the start of the attempt. Wardrobe is a neutral continuity choice.

The lowering uses foreground occlusion to imply contact without rendering joined hands. Do not show a key transfer, hand opening or key falling. If C-17 is not legible, replace the marking in post while preserving the motionless fist.

Match Aruni's stopped gaze across the wide and single, and her settled kneeling position between the lowering and reaction. Match the phone at her right ear into the final reaction. Nimal remains completely still.
Silent picture sources need rain, water, footsteps, breath and the single distant bus horn built in post; do not add an answer, connection tone or music. Keep L3 intact on its performer.
Black and the title are editorial graphics, not photographed rain-lit objects; make a clean hard cut to black and a separate precisely typeset title card.

Speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in and split screen are post-only options; none is required for this restrained cut. Shoot clean sources if post elects to use one. Avoid slow motion, generated lettering, intricate finger movement, visible body contact, mirrors and speculative details.

editor_notes: The bin is 60 seconds across 11 must sources; the intended cut is a reference, not a locked edit. Play the wide, recognition and identification in sequence, then the lowering and settled reaction, then the key, L3, the attempt, the horn, black and title.

The script does not specify hands or wardrobe: staging assigns the medical bag to Aruni's left hand and the enclosed key to Nimal's right fist; keep those assignments throughout. The phone appears in Aruni's right hand at the start of the attempt. Wardrobe is a neutral continuity choice.

The lowering uses foreground occlusion to imply contact without rendering joined hands. Do not show a key transfer, hand opening or key falling. If C-17 is not legible, replace the marking in post while preserving the motionless fist.

Match Aruni's stopped gaze across the wide and single, and her settled kneeling position between the lowering and reaction. Match the phone at her right ear into the final reaction. Nimal remains completely still.
Silent picture sources need rain, water, footsteps, breath and the single distant bus horn built in post; do not add an answer, connection tone or music. Keep L3 intact on its performer.
Black and the title are editorial graphics, not photographed rain-lit objects; make a clean hard cut to black and a separate precisely typeset title card.

Speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in and split screen are post-only options; none is required for this restrained cut. Shoot clean sources if post elects to use one. Avoid slow motion, generated lettering, intricate finger movement, visible body contact, mirrors and speculative details.

c14: Follow c09 as the distant horn passes, carrying c09's rain and horn tail; cut directly to c10.
c15: Optional opening before c01, over continuous rain and canal ambience; no dialogue.

review.why: An empty field-side approach introduces the geography and rain before the staged recognition.
The occluded lowering and existing settled reaction already carry the gesture and response; another angle would repeat them.
The locked fist insert already makes C-17 legible while preserving the key's position; another detail would duplicate the reveal.
The complete L3 performance should remain uninterrupted on its existing single.
A handset-and-grip insert and an isolated listening reaction give the unanswered wait physical detail and duration.
A restrained field-side withdrawal opens space around Aruni as the distant horn recedes, without introducing a vehicle.
The clean cut to black is an editorial source and needs no filmed transition.
The separate static title card needs no additional camera material.
